selection_process: Paper I Mental Ability Test 50 100 Qualifying; no negative marking
Paper II General Awareness & English Language 50 150 Counted for merit; negative marking applies
Paper III Concerned Subject 100 300 Counted for merit; negative marking applies
Selection for both posts follows a two-stage process:

Trade Test (Qualifying): Screened and eligible candidates are called for a Trade Test in the relevant area/ discipline. Competitive Written Examination: Candidates who qualify the Trade Test appear for a written exam of 200 questions across three papers
in a 3-hour OMR/ Computer-Based Objective Multiple-Choice format
set in English and Hindi (except the English language paper).
Paper II and Paper III are evaluated only for candidates who cross the minimum threshold marks in Paper I
and the final merit list is prepared based on performance in Paper II and Paper III combined.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website www.neeri.res.in or the recruitment portal http:/ / career.neeri.res.in.
Register using a valid name, email ID and mobile number, then log in with the generated credentials.
Fill in the online application form and upload the required scanned documents (photograph, signature, mark sheets, certificates) as per the specified format and size.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/ - online via SBI Collect, where applicable, and upload the fee receipt.
Verify all entered details, since no modification is permitted after final submission.
Submit the application and download/ print a copy of the completed application and payment details for personal record before 05:00 P.M. on 15/ 10/ 2026.
Only online applications are accepted; no other mode of application will be considered. A separate application and fee (where applicable) are required for each post code applied to.

content_sections.heading: CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant and Technical Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 13 vacancies are notified: 01 post of Technical Assistant and 12 posts of Technical Officer across eight post codes. The number of vacancies is provisional and may increase or decrease at the time of selection, as stated in the official notification. Note: Out of the 13 vacant posts, 1 post is reserved for PwBD Category (a), i.e. Blind and Low Vision (B & L.V.). Reservation abbreviations used: UR - Unreserved, SC - Scheduled Caste, ST - Scheduled Tribe, OBC (NCL) - Other Backward Class (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS - Economically Weaker Section, PwBD - Person with Benchmark Disability.

content_sections.heading: CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant and Technical Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold the essential qualification listed against their chosen post code in the vacancy table above, obtained from a University/ Institution/ Board recognised by the Government of India, with results declared on or before the closing date of the online application. The notification specifies that mere possession of the minimum qualification does not guarantee a call for the Trade Test; applications are screened by a duly constituted Screening Committee.

content_sections.heading: CSIR NEERI Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age for all posts is not below 18 years. The upper age limit, reckoned as on the closing date (15/ 10/ 2026), differs by post: Age relaxation is available for SC/ ST (5 years), OBC-NCL (3 years), PwBD (10 years for unreserved, more for reserved categories), Government employees (up to 5 years) and Ex-Servicemen (3 years), as per the detailed conditions in the official notification. content_sections.text: Selection for both posts follows a two-stage process: Trade Test (Qualifying): Screened and eligible candidates are called for a Trade Test in the relevant area/ discipline. Competitive Written Examination: Candidates who qualify the Trade Test appear for a written exam of 200 questions across three papers, in a 3-hour OMR/ Computer-Based Objective Multiple-Choice format, set in English and Hindi (except the English language paper). content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant and Technical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website www.neeri.res.in or the recruitment portal http:/ / career.neeri.res.in . Register using a valid name, email ID and mobile number, then log in with the generated credentials. Fill in the online application form and upload the required scanned documents (photograph, signature, mark sheets, certificates) as per the specified format and size. Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/ - online via SBI Collect, where applicable, and upload the fee receipt. Verify all entered details, since no modification is permitted after final submission. Submit the application and download/ print a copy of the completed application and payment details for personal record before 05:00 P.M. on 15/ 10/ 2026. Only online applications are accepted; no other mode of application will be considered. A separate application and fee (where applicable) are required for each post code applied to.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant positions is 15th October 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well before this date to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum and maximum age limits for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for the Technical Assistant post is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 27 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Technical Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Diploma in Engineering/Technology in a relevant discipline or a First Class Bachelor's degree in Science from a recognized institution to be eligible for the Technical Assistant post.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Technical Assistant position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies announced for the Technical Assistant post in the CSIR NEERI recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Technical Assistant post will be placed in Pay Matrix Level-8, with a salary ranging from Rs. 25,500 to Rs. 81,100 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Technical Assistant positions will involve a Written Examination followed by a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for the CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified educational and age criteria. The institute is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the CSIR NEERI Technical Assistant recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive is NEERI/2020.
